The style engine's font-metric fixtures are original synthetic faces with
rectangle outlines, generated by `scripts/generate-style-metrics-fonts.py`
with fixed timestamps (byte-for-byte reproducible with fontTools 4.60.2,
which is needed only to regenerate them). No third-party font data.

- `metrics.ttf`, `metrics-bold.ttf`: `Varta Metrics` at weights 400 and 700,
  with distinct x-heights (`OS/2` and `x` outline equal), cap-heights, `0`
  and `水` advances and `hhea` metrics, so each unit shows which face and
  value the engine read.
- `metrics-bare.ttf`: `Varta Metrics Bare`, `OS/2` version 1 mapping only
  space and `A`: every CSS Values 4 fallback.
- `metrics-variable.ttf`: `Varta Metrics Variable`, a `wght` 100 to 900 face
  whose x-height and cap-height (`MVAR`) and `0` advance (`HVAR`) vary.

The engine's tests, the cross-host corpus (`view_engine_tests`,
`view-engine.test.mjs`) and the Chrome comparison (`native_css_engine_probe`)
load these bytes.
